 Mammoth at Penguins projected lineups 
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 October 29, 2026 
 Link copied 
 MAMMOTH (8-5-0) PENGUINS (5-6-1) 
 7 p.m. ET; Mammoth+, Utah16, SN-PIT, SN, TVAS 
 Mammoth projected lineup 
 Clayton Keller -- Nick Schmaltz -- Lawson Crouse
 Logan Cooley -- Vincent Trocheck -- Dylan Guenther
 Anders Lee -- Barrett Hayton -- Kailer Yamamoto
 Jack McBain -- Kevin Stenlund -- Liam O’Brien
 Mikhail Sergachev -- Mackenzie Weegar
 Nate Schmidt -- Andrew Peeke
 Artem Duda -- Nick DeSimone
 Karel Vejmelka
 Sebastian Cossa
 Scratched:  Daniil But, Dmitri Simashev 
 Injured: Maveric Lamoureux (shoulder), Michael Carcone (upper body), John Marino (upper body)  
 Penguins projected lineup 
 Tommy Novak -- Sidney Crosby -- Rickard Rakell
 Egor Chinakhov -- Ben Kindel -- Evgeni Malkin
 Andrei Kuzmenko -- Henrdrix Lapierre -- Ville Koivunen
 Connor Dewar -- Blake Lizotte -- Nick Robertson
 Spencer Stastney -- Erik Karlsson
 Samuel Girard -- Kaedan Korczak
 Declan Carlile -- Kris Letang
 Arturs Silovs
 Sergei Murashov
 Scratched: Ilya Solovyov, Rutger McGroarty 
 Injured: Justin Brazeau (lower body), Ryan Graves (knee), Trevor van Riemsdyk (lower body), Bryan Rust (lower body), Elmer Soderblom (upper body) 
 Status report 
 Duda will make his NHL debut, Mammoth coach Andre Tournigny said; Simashev, a defenseman, could come out. ... Kindel will play for the first time since fainting while aboard the Penguins team plane on Oct. 20 due to a vasovagal episode, a sudden drop in heart rate and blood pressure that reduces blood flow to the brain; he missed two games. ... Pittsburgh could get three other players back; Malkin is expected to return after missing one game because of an illness, Chinakhov should play after missing two games with a lower-body injury and Girard will be a game-time decision after practicing in a regular contact jersey Wednesday for the first time since sustaining a lower-body injury on Oct. 17. ... Soderblom is day to day; the forward played 13:52 in a 3-2 overtime win against the Nashville Predators on Saturday.
